data.body: SUPERSEDED (ADR-0022, 2026-06-04): the HMAC-signed admin-exemption ledger this story built is RETIRED + replaced by IDENTITY-BASED admin exemption — a covering PR merged by a designated bypass-actor (ruleset.bypass_user_ids, server-set merged_by, forge-proof since the agent is current_user_can_bypass:never) is reviewed-equivalent; no signing key, no ledger. admin-exemption-ledger.sh / ael_* / fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh / .admin-exemption-ledger deleted. Story stays CLOSED — its GOAL (propagate an admin bypass so it doesn't re-wedge later PRs) is achieved by the superseding mechanism, more simply. See ADR-0022, 3ebb, 3ee4 P8c.
